summary: The study describes the use of atomic layer deposition (ALD) to engineer electrocatalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). The ALD process was used to deposit a ternary Fe0.54Co0.46S0.92 compound on a carbon nanotube/carbon cloth (CNTs/CC) electrode. The ALD process allowed for precise compositional control and uniform coating, resulting in a low overpotential of −70 mV for achieving −10 mA/cm² current density in alkaline solution.
evidence: FexCo1−xSy films were grown by ALD at 120 °C from the precursors, including bis(N,N′-diisopropylacetamidinato)-cobalt(II), bis(N,N′-diisopropylacetamidinato)iron(II), and H2S, in a home-built tubular reactor.
